mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (reservation_no, user_id, room_id, reserve_date, start_time, end_time, topic, attendee_count, contact, purpose, status) VALUES (#{reservationNo}, #{userId}, #{roomId}, #{reserveDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{topic}, #{attendeeCount}, #{contact}, #{purpose}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, reservation_no, user_id, room_id, reserve_date, start_time, end_time, topic, attendee_count, contact, purpose, status, cancel_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM reservation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id, r.reservation_no AS reservationNo, r.room_id AS roomId, m.name AS roomName, m.location AS location, r.reserve_date AS date, r.start_time AS startTime, r.end_time AS endTime, r.topic, r.attendee_count AS attendeeCount, r.contact, r.purpose, r.status, r.cancel_reason AS cancelReason FROM reservation r JOIN meeting_room m ON m.id = r.room_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.start_time DESC, r.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET room_id = #{roomId}, reserve_date = #{reserveDate}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, topic = #{topic}, attendee_count = #{attendeeCount}, contact = #{contact}, purpose = #{purpose}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE reservation SET status = #{status}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE reservation SET status = 'FINISHED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND end_time < NOW()
